text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chairs cabinet meeting on report on prospects for Tunisian economy over next 10 years.
- Parliament discussed presidency's budget for 1997. National Solidarity Fund, part of presidency's affairs, will intervene in 178 areas to help 38,000 families.
- Tunis Air starts fourth weekly flight to London in April.
- 62 firms have set up plans for modernisation.
- Tunisians respond massively to president's call to contribute to National Solidarity Fund.
